text:
Situation: Nicardipine hydrochloride 25 mg/10 mL vials are low at all three Corvale sites. Corvale East has 222 vials (16.9 days), Corvale General has 226 vials (15.7 days), and Corvale Lakeside has 86 vials (27.9 days). FDA's records show nicardipine hydrochloride is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage database does not list nicardipine hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is tight but not in FDA shortage. We should secure additional stock now using the ranked supplier list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places purchase order with Caplin Steriles Limited; Pharmacy Director approves.
2. Buyer places purchase order with Cipla USA Inc.; Pharmacy Director approves.
3. Buyer places purchase order with Qilu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.; Pharmacy Director approves.
4. Buyer places purchase order with Sagent Pharmaceuticals; Pharmacy Director approves.
5. Buyer places purchase order with American Regent, Inc.; Pharmacy Director approves.

Not recommended: Delaying orders until a formal shortage is declared.
